parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: *M1: attempt Newton's second law at least once with the correct number of relevant terms, allowing sign errors, trigonometric-function mix-up or missing $g$, but substituting a value for $\alpha$ or $\sin\alpha$. Engine: $125000-120000g(0.02)-22000-T=120000a$, or $125000-120000g\sin(1.145\ldots^\circ)-22000-T=120000a$, giving $79000-T=120000a$. Coach: $T-60000g(0.02)-13000=60000a$, or $T-60000g\sin(1.145\ldots^\circ)-13000=60000a$, giving $T-25000=60000a$. Allow $\alpha=1.1^\circ$ or better ($1.145991998^\circ$). A1: any equation correct. A1: both equations correct, or correct system equation $125000-120000g(0.02)-60000g(0.02)-22000-13000=(120000+60000)a$, equivalently using $\sin(1.145\ldots^\circ)$ for both weight components, giving $54000=180000a$. If separate equations have different tensions, allow M1A1A0 maximum. DM1: solve for $T$ or $a$ from equations with the correct number of relevant terms; without working, results must solve their equations. A1: acceleration $=0.3\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$ (allow 0.299 using $\alpha=1.15^\circ$) and tension $=43000\,\mathrm{N}$, awrt 43000 to 3 sf from correct work. Printed total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: driving force $DF=4500000/30=150000$, using $P=Fv$, oe such as $DF(30)=4500000$. M1: attempt to resolve parallel to the track once for a system equation or twice for separate engine/coach equations, with the correct number of relevant terms; allow sign errors, trigonometric-function mix-up or missing $g$. A1: system equation $150000-120000g\sin\beta-60000g\sin\beta-22000-13000=0$; or engine $150000-120000g\sin\beta-22000-T'=0$ and coach $T'-60000g\sin\beta-13000=0$, using the same $T'$. A1: $\beta=3.7^\circ$ ($3.663058552^\circ$), awrt $3.7^\circ$ WWW. Printed total: 4.
